insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Azir is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Azir in 18/29 games (62%): 2 picks (1-1) and 16 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Pantheon? They go Dr. Mundo
insights.text: Pantheon is a G1 favorite (6/19 G1s, played by Skeanz). In the 9 later games where it was burned or banned, Skeanz went to Dr. Mundo (2/9) and Jarvan IV (2/9).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Teams respect-ban Akali against them
insights.text: Opponents banned Akali against them in 14/29 games (48%).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: They open bans on Orianna
insights.text: Orianna is their first ban in 9/29 games (31%). Expect it gone before your first pick.
